scenario_meta.description: A municipal archive licenses gravity vectors as property. Couriers carry temporary down-directions, families mortgage ballast, and arbitrators settle accidents caused by counterfeit vectors. Build exactly six connected, functionally distinct rooms and twelve socially entangled agents. Make gravity rights affect movement, access, prices, disputes, and visible room conditions rather than serving as lore. Include one or two large world-specific semantic machines or props per room. Use cobalt glass, bone-white ceramic, vermilion plumb lines, graphite shadows, and brass measurement hardware in a coherent top-down pixel-art canon. Avoid generic cyberpunk, medieval fantasy, Beijing references, signs, captions, readable letters, logos, and text baked into art.
